sentences.1: Organizations should carefully consider conducting DPIAs for large-scale processing, profiling or monitoring, decisions on service access or opportunities, or processing of sensitive data or vulnerable individuals.
sentences.2: You should also think carefully about doing a DPIA for any other processing that is large scale, involves profiling or monitoring, decides on access to services or opportunities, or involves sensitive data or vulnerable individuals.
sentences.3: To determine whether processing is on a large scale, one should consider the number of individuals concerned, volume of data, variety of data, duration of processing, and geographical extent.
sentences.4: The scope of processing should include details about the nature, volume, variety, sensitivity, extent, frequency, duration of processing, number of data subjects, and geographical area covered.
sentences.5: to decide whether processing is on a large scale you should consider: the number of individuals concerned;
sentences.6: and the geographical extent of the processing.
sentences.7: the volume and variety of the personal data;
sentences.8: A DPIA is required for large-scale processing of special categories of data or personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences.
sentences.9: processing on a large scale of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1) of the GDPR, or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10 of the GDPR processing on a large scale of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1), or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10
